title: Plans Fade Fast: Why Context Management Is Load-Bearing for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.22953v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Context managers summarize or evict old messages so agents can operate beyond a finite window. This creates a reliability problem: removing history that still shapes the model's computation may change later actions, while retaining everything defeats compression. We study plans because agents create them early and are expected to use them later, yet behavioral success alone cannot reveal whether later calls still depend on the plan exchange. We make four contributions. First, we introduce replay pairing, which holds the action-observation trajectory fixed and compares pre-action hidden states with and without the plan exchange. We show that, on Llama-3.1-70B in ALFWorld, the mean contrast across 15 sampled layers decreases 4.1x from the first post-plan action to the second; Llama-3.1-8B shows a similar 5.6x decrease. translated_title: 计划迅速消退：为什么上下文管理对大语言模型智能体至关重要
translated_abstract: 上下文管理器通过总结或清除旧消息，使智能体能够在有限窗口之外运作。这带来了一个可靠性问题：移除仍在影响模型计算的历史记录可能会改变后续动作，而保留全部内容又使压缩失去意义。我们之所以研究计划，是因为智能体在早期创建计划并被期望在后续使用它们，然而仅凭行为上的成功无法判断后续调用是否仍依赖于计划交换。我们做出了四项贡献。首先，我们提出重放配对方法，即在保持动作-观察轨迹不变的情况下，比较有无计划交换时的动作前隐藏状态。我们证明，在ALFWorld环境中的Llama-3.1-70B上，从计划后第一个动作到第二个动作，15个采样层的平均对比度下降了4.1倍；Llama-3.1-8B也表现出类似的5.6倍下降。其次，我们证明使用第32层隐藏状态的简单线性模型能够在完全保留的轨迹上预测后续对比度……
tldr: 该论文提出“重放配对”方法，通过固定轨迹对比隐藏状态，发现大语言模型智能体在创建计划后其内部影响会迅速消退（一步之内衰减4至6倍），且可用简单线性模型预测这种消退，从而揭示了上下文管理对智能体可靠性为何如此关键。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "replay pairing" to show that a plan's internal influence on LLM agents fades rapidly within a single action (4-6x decay) and can be predicted by a simple linear model, revealing why context management is load-bearing for agent reliability.
